about: The pane's Agents bar. Each button enrols a standing agent on the workspace's canvas with `isocan rc add <name> --harness <harness> --model <model>`. A name is an agent's, never a model's or a vendor's (`isocan --agent-help agents`). A null harness means this machine's default (`isocan harness`). A model is spelled the way that harness spells it, and the pane says when a harness has no way to take one (`pinsModel`). Edit freely, or point ISOCAN_JETSKI_PRESETS at a file of your own.
